# Aetas Impact

> Aetas Impact is the purpose-led advisory arm of the Aetas group. We help charities, not-for-profits, social enterprises, community interest companies, foundations, trusts, educational organisations and faith organisations across the UK build organisational resilience, strengthen governance, and sustain long-term impact.

One philosophy, three systems: Aetas believes that better decisions create better futures. That belief is expressed through three specialist systems — Life Stage Planning at Aetas Wealth, the Aetas Performance System (measured by Return on Employee Investment, ROEI), and the Aetas Impact System (measured by the Mission Resilience Index, MRI).

Aetas Impact works with purpose-led organisations through the Impact Framework: a structured approach to people, governance and capacity that builds the foundations lasting mission delivery requires.

## What we do

- Impact Review: a structured, no-cost two-part diagnostic for purpose-led organisations identifying where pressure exists across people, governance and capacity, and what a proportionate response looks like. Written summary suitable for trustees.
- People: benefits and pension review, financial education, and one-to-one regulated guidance for employees. Typically identifies annual savings exceeding the programme cost in year one.
- Governance: trustee support, governance reporting, funder credibility, Charity Governance Code alignment.
- Capacity: organisational resilience, income diversification, leadership focus, strategic clarity.
- Impact Diagnostic: fifteen-question self-assessment across four areas of organisational resilience. Scored results with personalised interpretation. No data stored.

## Who we work with

Charities, not-for-profits, social enterprises, community interest companies (CICs), foundations, trusts, educational organisations, faith organisations, and any organisation where purpose is the primary organising principle.

## Entry point

The Impact Review is always provided at no cost and with no obligation. Book at: https://charities.aetas-wealth.com/book-a-meeting

## Fees

The Impact Review is free. Where a programme is recommended, fees are per-employee, agreed in writing before delivery begins, and presented alongside the savings identified so trustees see the net position before approving. Indicative full programme rates: approximately 140 to 165 GBP per employee per year.

## Regulatory

Aetas Impact is delivered by Matthew Steiner. Where regulated financial advice is required, this is provided by Aetas Wealth, a trading style of Insight Financial Associates Limited, authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA registration: 458421).

## The Aetas group

- Aetas Wealth (https://aetas-wealth.com): independent financial planning for individuals, families and business owners. Relevant for trustees, executives and senior leaders managing personal wealth alongside their mission.
- Aetas in the Workplace (https://workplace.aetas-wealth.com): workplace financial wellbeing for commercial employers.
- Aetas Impact (https://charities.aetas-wealth.com): advisory for purpose-led organisations.
